overview: India International Jewellery Week (IIJW) Support is a scheme by the Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council (GJEPC) to promote participation in the IIJW trade show. It provides benefits such as rate locks, discounted rates, no security deposit, and exclusive benefits like complimentary hotel rooms and food coupons for members who opt into the IIJS Prime Assure Scheme for multiple financial years. The scheme aims to facilitate long-term business planning and ensure economy of participation for GJEPC members in international jewellery exhibitions.
objectives: Facilitate long-term business planning for GJEPC members
Ensure economy of participation in IIJS Bharat shows
Provide rate lock for participation rates over two financial years
Offer discounted rates for Prime Assure scheme over single show application
Eliminate security deposit requirements for two years
Provide exclusive benefits such as complimentary hotel rooms and food coupons at IIJS Bharat - Tritiya
Enable early show entry and access to IIJS Prime+ Lounge
Offer networking evening pass, Innov8 Launchpad discounts, and hotel booking priority
Provide sponsorship opportunities with 5% discount and priority listing in digital exhibitor directory
Offer parking facility benefits at Bombay Exhibition Centre
eligibility: GJEPC members who have completed membership registration/renewal and possess valid login credentials are eligible to apply for the IIJS Prime Assure Scheme or single show application for IIJS Bharat – Premiere 2026. Applicants must be verified members of recognized trade associations.
benefits: Rate Lock: Same participation rates for IIJS Bharat – Premiere, IIJS Bharat – Signature and IIJS Bharat – Tritiya for a period of two years (2026-28). Discount Benefit Offer: Discounted rates for IIJS Prime Assure Scheme (6 shows) over single show application. No Security Deposit: No security deposits for 2 years. Exclusive Benefits at IIJS Bharat - Tritiya for Prime Assure Exhibitor: Complimentary Hotel Room (3 Nights) Complimentary Food Coupons 18 – 27 sqm: 1 Room 18 – 27 sqm: ₹7,500 36 – 72 sqm: 2 Rooms 36 – 72 sqm: ₹17,500 108 sqm: 3 Rooms 108 sqm: ₹22,500. Facilities and benefits: Early Show Entry: Access to the exhibition 30 minutes prior to the official opening hours. IIJS Prime+ Lounge: Access to Prime+ Badge (Owner Exhibitors) in the IIJS Prime+ Lounge. Networking Evening Pass: Available at discounted rates. Innov8 Launchpad: 25% discount on booking slots. Hotel Booking Priority: One-day early access to hotel room bookings for participating exhibitors. Sponsorship Opportunities: Priority access along with a 5% discount. Priority Listing: Special Prime Assure listing in the Digital Exhibitor Directory. Parking Facility: – 27 sqm and above: Parking at Bombay Exhibition Centre (BEC) – 9 sqm to 18 sqm: Parking at Lodha MCGM
financial_support: The scheme provides financial benefits through discounted participation rates, elimination of security deposits, and complimentary services such as hotel rooms and food coupons. The discount benefit offer ensures reduced costs for members opting for the multi-show Prime Assure Scheme compared to single show applications. Specific financial values include complimentary food coupons worth ₹7,500 for 18–27 sqm, ₹17,500 for 36–72 sqm, and ₹22,500 for 108 sqm stall sizes at IIJS Bharat - Tritiya.
application_process: 1. Visit the IIJS Bharat Shows space application portal. 2. Log in using existing username and password (same as used for membership registration/renewal) at https://registration.gjepc.org/login.php. 3. New members must register on the same portal. 4. Fill out the space application form for IIJS Prime Assure Scheme (6 show) or IIJS Bharat – Premiere 2026 (single show). 5. Submit the application form along with advance payment on or before 30th April 2026 to avail the exclusive Discount Benefit Offer of IIJS Prime Assure. 6. Ensure submission is completed by the deadline to retain preference status for space allotment.
deadlines: The space application for all 6 IIJS Bharat shows for the year 2026–28 will open on 13th April 2026. Applications must be submitted on or before 30th April 2026 to avail the exclusive Discount Benefit Offer of IIJS Prime Assure and continue with the preference status offered to different categories.
implementing_agency: Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council (GJEPC)
caveats: Submission of application for prime assure does not guarantee stall allotment; allotment is subject to availability of space.

An exhibitor is free to cancel participation at any time during the Prime assure period of 2026-28, but if not allotted space under the IIJS Prime Assure Scheme, they will not be considered as a Prime Assure Exhibitor for the remaining shows and will not be eligible to avail any Prime Assure benefits.

If the online space application form and advance payment are not received on or before 30th April 2026, the applicant will automatically lose their preference for allotment of space at IIJS Bharat - Premiere 2026 (single show) or for applying for Prime Assure Scheme with price lock and other benefits for IIJS Bharat - Premiere 2026 & 2027, IIJS Bharat - Signature 2027 & 2028 and IIJS Bharat - Tritiya 2027 & 2028.

In case of non-submission or incomplete submission of the application within 30th April 2026, the application will be automatically rejected without any notice, and such members will not be eligible for further consideration in the scheme of preferential allotment of space for participation at single or multiple IIJS Bharat shows.
No counter sale will be permitted during the Exhibition; violators may be debarred from participating in the Exhibition and any future exhibitions organized by the Council.
